name: enterprise-rag-platform
description: 面向单一企业内网的生产级 RAG 知识库

scripts.build:backend: nest build platform-api && nest build rag-query-service && nest build ingestion-worker && nest build scheduler-worker && nest build document-parser-service
scripts.dev:platform-api: cross-env APP_NAME=platform-api HTTP_PORT=3000 nest start platform-api --watch
scripts.dev:rag-query-service: cross-env APP_NAME=rag-query-service HTTP_PORT=3001 nest start rag-query-service --watch
scripts.dev:ingestion-worker: cross-env APP_NAME=ingestion-worker PROBE_PORT=3002 nest start ingestion-worker --watch
scripts.dev:scheduler-worker: cross-env APP_NAME=scheduler-worker PROBE_PORT=3003 nest start scheduler-worker --watch
scripts.dev:document-parser-service: cross-env APP_NAME=document-parser-service HTTP_PORT=8104 nest start document-parser-service --watch
scripts.dev:services: concurrently -k -n platform,query,ingestion,scheduler,parser,web -c blue,cyan,yellow,magenta,red,green "pnpm dev:platform-api" "pnpm dev:rag-query-service" "pnpm dev:ingestion-worker" "pnpm dev:scheduler-worker" "pnpm dev:document-parser-service" "pnpm dev:web"
scripts.dev:all: pnpm dev:infra && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm seed:dev && pnpm dev:services
scripts.dev:docker: cross-env RAG_ENV_FILE=../../.env.external-dev.example docker compose --profile m03 --env-file deploy/docker/images.external.env -f deploy/docker/docker-compose.yml -f deploy/docker/docker-compose.apps.yml up -d --build
scripts.test:integration: pnpm db:migrate && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules RUN_INTEGRATION_TESTS=true jest --runInBand --config test/jest-integration.config.cjs
scripts.docker:check:apps: cross-env RAG_ENV_FILE=../../.env.external-dev.example docker compose --profile m03 --env-file deploy/docker/images.external.env -f deploy/docker/docker-compose.yml -f deploy/docker/docker-compose.apps.yml config --quiet
scripts.docker:check:intranet: cross-env RAG_ENV_FILE=../../.env.intranet-production.example docker compose --env-file deploy/docker/images.intranet.example.env -f deploy/docker/docker-compose.intranet.yml config --quiet
scripts.docker:check: pnpm docker:check:external && pnpm docker:check:apps && pnpm docker:check:intranet
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm boundary && pnpm test && pnpm migration:check && pnpm offline:audit && pnpm build && pnpm openapi:check && pnpm docker:check
